Normalize marker values to percent of control

Source: R/normalization.R
normalize_to_control.Rd

Expresses each marker measurement (or a biological target-cell viability / cell-death metric computed from user-selected dead_markers and viable_markers / total_markers) as a percentage of the mean control (untreated/vehicle) value within the same patient. This is the standard first step for building dose response curves and estimating \(\mathrm{IC}_{50}\) in drug sensitivity assays, following Labrosse et al. (2024) doi:10.1016/j.xpro.2024.103274.

When dead_markers (e.g. "cCASP3") and viable_markers (e.g. "EpCAM_E-Cadherin") or total_markers (e.g. c("EpCAM_E-Cadherin", "cCASP3")) are supplied, normalize_to_control() first computes for each well/image:

  • dead_cells_ratio: sum of dead_markers

  • total_target_cells_ratio: sum of total_markers (living target cells + dying cells, excluding unrelated DAPI-only stromal cells)

  • viable_cells_ratio: total_target_cells_ratio - dead_cells_ratio

  • dead_fraction: dead_cells_ratio / total_target_cells_ratio

  • viable_fraction: 1 - dead_fraction (viable_cells_ratio / total_target_cells_ratio)

and then normalizes the chosen response_metric ("viability" or "cell_death") against the matched control_treatment_name group.

Usage

normalize_to_control(
  .data,
  control_treatment_name = "Control",
  treatment_column_name = "Treatment",
  group_by_columns = "PID",
  value_columns = NULL,
  pattern_column_markers = "_ratio_of_total_cells",
  dead_markers = NULL,
  viable_markers = NULL,
  total_markers = NULL,
  response_metric = c("viability", "cell_death"),
  selected_treatments = NULL,
  consensus_only = FALSE
)

Arguments

.data

A data frame in either the wide format returned by make_count_dataframe() or the long format returned by change_data_format_to_longer().

control_treatment_name

Value identifying control/vehicle wells in treatment_column_name. Defaults to "Control".

treatment_column_name

Column holding the treatment label. Defaults to "Treatment".

group_by_columns

Columns that define a comparable batch: the control mean is computed within each combination of these columns. Defaults to "PID".

value_columns

Columns to normalize. If NULL, uses "marker_positivity_ratio" when present (long format), otherwise all columns matching pattern_column_markers (wide format).

pattern_column_markers

Pattern used to auto-detect marker columns in wide format. Defaults to "_ratio_of_total_cells".

dead_markers

Optional character vector of marker name(s) representing dead/dying cells (e.g. "cCASP3" or c("cCASP3", "E-Cadherin and cCASP3")). Matches names with or without the "_ratio_of_total_cells" suffix.

viable_markers

Optional character vector of marker name(s) representing viable target/cancer cells (e.g. "EpCAM_E-Cadherin" or "E-Cadherin"). When multiple viable_markers and dead_markers are supplied, markers are paired positionally if length(viable_markers) == length(dead_markers); otherwise all combinations are evaluated alongside a combined consensus panel.

total_markers

Optional character vector of marker name(s) representing the total target cell population (e.g. c("EpCAM_E-Cadherin", "cCASP3")). If NULL when dead_markers and viable_markers are provided, defaults to unique(c(viable_markers, dead_markers)).

response_metric

Metric to compute and normalize when dead_markers is provided: "viability" (default, 1 - dead / total, which starts at 100% in control and decreases toward 0% as cells die) or "cell_death" (dead / total).

selected_treatments

Optional character vector of treatment names to keep (in addition to control_treatment_name). Defaults to NULL (all treatments).

consensus_only

Logical; when multiple viable_markers or dead_markers are supplied and consensus_only = FALSE (the default), normalize_to_control() computes each individual marker pair's readout as well as a combined "Consensus (Combined)" readout across all selected markers. Set consensus_only = TRUE to return only the combined consensus readout.

Value

.data with an added column per normalized value: "_pct_of_control" in wide format, or a single "pct_of_control" column in long format. When dead_markers is supplied, also includes dead_cells_ratio, viable_cells_ratio, total_target_cells_ratio, dead_fraction, viable_fraction, and is_consensus.

Examples

# A patient with a control group and one drug at three doses
df <- data.frame(
  PID = "PID1",
  Treatment = c("Control", "Control", "DrugA", "DrugA", "DrugA"),
  cCASP3_ratio_of_total_cells = c(10, 10, 5, 20, 40)
)
normalize_to_control(df)
#>    PID Treatment cCASP3_ratio_of_total_cells
#> 1 PID1   Control                          10
#> 2 PID1   Control                          10
#> 3 PID1     DrugA                           5
#> 4 PID1     DrugA                          20
#> 5 PID1     DrugA                          40
#>   cCASP3_ratio_of_total_cells_pct_of_control
#> 1                                        100
#> 2                                        100
#> 3                                         50
#> 4                                        200
#> 5                                        400
